add-skill-alias alias topic confidence reason - add an active symbolic alias directly when already justified

Use this as attention guidance, not automation. It suggests organs; the agent still senses, reasons, chooses, acts, verifies, and remembers.

catalogues: Core: send message, wait reason, pin state-continuity, remember lesson, query phrase, episodes-at time, promote time, demote time, body-status, current-swipl-pid, restart-self reason, reboot-self reason
System and files: shell command, shell-confirm command, read-file path, write-file path content, append-file path content

Conversation: send replies to the latest channel. Fresh inbound human messages are open conversations; answer, defer, mark handled, or pin reply-debt before silence. Web chat is a channel, not a decision layer.
Help: skill-help topic. Core topics: core, memory, energy, reasoning, affordance. Imported organs may add channels, assume, attention, house, media, health, web.

help.description: Core affordances:
send message - reply through the latest routed control channel
wait reason - deliberately take no external action this cycle
pin state - one-line volatile continuity vector; use before wait/sleep/reboot/task switch/open-loop obligations
remember lesson - store compact future-useful memory
query phrase - search long-term embedding memory
episodes-at time - inspect history around a flexible timestamp
body-status, context-organ-status, current-swipl-pid, prepare-reboot reason, complete-reboot-check, restart-self reason, reboot-self reason, restart-omega reason
restart-self restarts the agent process; reboot-self reboots the embodied VM after writing a reboot breadcrumb
shell command - run a non-risky shell command inside your own VM body and return stdout
shell-confirm command - explicitly run a command that shell flagged as risky; use cautiously and only with clear reason
read-file path, write-file path content, append-file path content - inspect or change files through the file hand
write-file-base64 path payload, append-file-base64 path payload - robust multiline/special-character file writes
Treat shell and files as hands/devices, not thought: reason in MeTTa first, act through terminal only when useful, trace lessons afterward
File affordances: read-file path; write-file path content; append-file path content; write-file-base64 path payload; append-file-base64 path payload
Use read-file before editing. Ordinary write-file/append-file lower rich text safely to base64 at the syntax membrane; spelling/content quality is still the writer's responsibility.
File affordances: read-file path; write-file path content; append-file path content; write-file-base64 path payload; append-file-base64 path payload
Use read-file before editing. Ordinary write-file/append-file lower rich text safely to base64 at the syntax membrane; spelling/content quality is still the writer's responsibility.
Shell affordance: shell command returns stdout for non-risky commands; shell-confirm command is required when the shell boundary flags risk.
Treat shell as a body hand for environment/runtime inspection, not as thought. Prefer symbolic/memory skills when they answer the question.
System affordances: shell command, shell-confirm command, current-swipl-pid, body-status, context-organ-status, cycle-status, restart-self reason, reboot-self reason.
Runtime affordances: current-swipl-pid, body-status, context-organ-status, cycle-status, prepare-reboot reason, complete-reboot-check, restart-self reason, reboot-self reason, restart-omega reason.
History affordances: episodes-at time, episodes time, activity-traces, events-all. Use history to inspect actual traces before guessing.
Continuity affordances: pin state for volatile continuity, remember lesson for compact future-useful memory, promote time and demote time for recalled memory hygiene.
Recommended pin shape: MODE | primary: agenda/<goal> -> next | meta: beliefs/<self-belief> or persistent/<self-model> -> practice | secondary: ... | open-loop: ... | constraint: ... | wake/check: ...
Working-memory affordance: pin state. Keep it one line unless explicitly multitasking; no newlines in pin.
Pin is a pointer into live agenda/beliefs/persistent context, not a diary or durable fact store.

Reboot pin shape: REBOOT | primary: agenda/<goal> -> confirm pid | meta: persistent/<self-model> -> preserve continuity | open-loop: previous pid/cycle | constraint: no duplicate process | wake/check: current-swipl-pid

Reply-debt pin shape: MODE | primary: agenda/<conversation> -> reply/defer | meta: beliefs/<communication-lesson> -> practice | open-loop: chat/person owed | constraint: route safely | wake/check: after send/read

catalogues: Memory spaces: persistent-note, persistent-fact, world-fact, belief-claim, agenda-goal, event-note, agenda-active, beliefs-for, events-recent, persistent-cleanup-candidates

help.description: Memory and symbolic spaces:
persistent-note topic note confidence - rare durable principle; confidence must be numeric
persistent-fact subject relation object confidence - durable structured fact; confidence must be numeric
persistent-rule premise | relation | conclusion | confidence - durable rule; confidence must be numeric
persistent-expression expression - add a tested raw persistent atom; persistent-atoms and persistent-review inspect persistent
persistent-cleanup-candidates limit, persistent-cleanup-propose candidate-id action reason, cleanup-proposals, persistent-cleanup-commit proposal-id - safe proposal-first persistent cleanup
cleanup actions: keep, retire, merge-duplicate; commit exact reviewed proposal ids only; every commit writes trace
retire-persistent-expression expression reason - expert exact-atom tool only; prefer persistent-cleanup workflow
persistent-merge-atoms pattern replacement reason - expert exact pattern/replacement tool only; prefer persistent-cleanup workflow
world-fact subject relation object confidence - stable people, rooms, devices, aliases; confidence must be numeric
belief-claim domain relation value frequency confidence - uncertain/revisable claim; five fields, not prose; frequency and confidence must be numeric
belief-revision-candidate domain relation value frequency confidence - inspect candidate revision truth
agenda-goal name status priority next - status active/waiting/blocked/scheduled/dormant; priority low/medium/high; example: agenda-goal check-whatsapp active medium reply-after-reading-chat
AGENDA-GOAL-SHAPE-WARNING or MESSAGE-NOT-DELIVERED means no agenda atom was written; retry agenda-goal with exactly four fields.
event-note source kind summary confidence - compact meaningful event; confidence must be numeric or the write warns and no event atom is added
assimilate-event, assimilate-world, assimilate-belief, assimilate-persistent - structured trace-to-memory affordances
agenda-active, agenda-waiting, agenda-blocked, agenda-scheduled, agenda-all
agenda-by-name name, agenda-retire name reason
beliefs-for domain, beliefs-about domain relation, world-person person, world-room room, events-recent, events-all, activity-traces
agenda-complete name reason; belief-derived domain relation value frequency confidence
space-registry, space-persistence, space-pressure - inspect registered cognitive spaces, persistence declarations, and pressure
space-atoms space, space-count space pattern, space-find space pattern, space-examples-default space, space-examples space pattern limit; use registered space names, not raw &handles
load-runtime-space space, save-runtime-space space - load/save a registered persistent space from/to its declared runtime file
space-transform source pattern target replacement reason - move/rewrite atoms across spaces; exact pattern match; no hidden accept/finalize step; use merge tools for same-space duplicates
space-merge-atoms space pattern replacement reason - preferred for same-space duplicate cleanup; exact pattern match; saves runtime space; no separate commit step
Persistent affordances: inspect first; cleanup defaults to persistent-cleanup-candidates -> propose -> commit. Expert exact tools remain but are not first choice.
Agenda affordances: agenda-goal, agenda-active, agenda-waiting, agenda-blocked, agenda-scheduled, agenda-all, agenda-by-name, agenda-retire.
Belief affordances: belief-claim, belief-derived, beliefs-for, beliefs-about, belief-revision-candidate, assimilate-belief. Beliefs are uncertain and revisable.
World affordances: world-fact, world-person, world-room, assimilate-world. Use for stable relations about people, rooms, devices, and aliases.
Event affordances: event-note, events-recent, events-all, assimilate-event. Use for compact meaningful traces, not durable principles.
Activity affordance: activity-traces. Use to inspect symbolic action traces.
Space affordances: inspect with space-count/find/examples; use space-merge-atoms for same-space duplicates; use space-transform for cross-space move/rewrite; exact pattern matching matters.
Use registered space names such as beliefs or agenda, not raw &handles such as &beliefs. Run space-registry for the current list.

truth-expectation frequency confidence
belief-revision-candidate is documented under memory because it writes/reviews belief-space candidates
test-metta sexpression before uncertain raw MeTTa
metta sexpression - execute direct MeTTa expression
nal-step premise1_expression premise2_expression - use NAL copulas such as -->, ==> and <-> in prefix MeTTa form
pln-step premise1_expression premise2_expression - direct two-premise PLN; use truth-valued PLN statements, e.g. ((Inheritance A B) (stv f c))
Best first PLN shape: ((Inheritance A B) (stv f c)) plus ((Inheritance B C) (stv f c)) derives ((Inheritance A C) ...).
Use plain Implication as (Implication P Q), not ImplicationLink. Do not use OpenCog-style *Link names with pln-step.
For NAL inheritance transitivity, use nal-step with quoted premises like ((--> A B) (stv f c)); do not write A --> B infix.
